gaps: Pre-1999 NAIA polls: no weekly poll documents found. Only the 1981-82 men's No. 1 run (8 straight weeks, per Biola story) is recorded; 1990s seasons (e.g., 1991-92 33-4) not checked against any poll archive.

1999-00 through 2004-05 NAIA DI ratings come from web.archive.org copies of the old naia.org/basketball/{mdi,wdi}/ratings/ pages; a few weekly pages were never archived (e.g., men's 1999-00 Feb. 22, 2000 poll, 2000-01 poll 1, 2002-03 polls 5+ contain no Biola, 2004-05 polls 6-7 & 9). Missing weeks are partly filled from the next poll's 'previous' column.

Women's NAIA 1999-00 through 2004-05: archived ratings pages checked; Biola appears only in 2002-03 (preseason No. 23, peak No. 12 Dec. 3, 2002) and as receiving votes in 2003-04/2004-05. Women's 2005-06 to 2008-09 pages only partly archived; no Biola mentions found in those that were.
2005-06 to 2008-09 NAIA releases: only partially archived (2008-09 men's polls 2-8 mostly missing; women's 2008-09 almost nothing archived).

2009-10 and 2010-11 NAIA polls come from Victory Sports Network reprints; men's 2009-10 preseason and polls 1-3, and men's 2010-11 polls 3-5 (Jan. 2011) were not found (VSN pages for those redirected). Women's 2009-10 polls before Dec. 22 and after Feb. 22 not found.

2011-12 through 2016-17 NAIA polls: archived naia.org releases found for most weeks, but several weekly polls were never archived (notably men's 2016-17 polls of Dec. 6/13, Dec. 20?, Jan. 10-24, Feb. 7-21, and final; Biola was No. 1 on Dec. 6 and Dec. 13, 2016). Post-tournament NAIA final polls generally not captured.
'Previous' column rows (date null) are taken from the previous-rank column of the next poll; they are primary-source values but the exact release date of that poll is unknown.
Weeks_ranked in season_summaries counts only polls actually found (lower bound), excluding preseason.

Women's NCAA-era national polls: WBCA DII Coaches Poll - Biola never appears in the MST compiled DII women's poll history (top 25 only; receiving-votes lists not compiled). WBCA weekly PDFs (wbca.org) were not individually checked for receiving votes.

D2SIDA/D2CSC women's polls for 2019-20 and 2022-23 onward not located (hosting moved between schools); the Dec. 2019 West Region RV comes from a Biola story only. 2018-19 and 2019-20 hub pages (gomountainlions.com) contained no Biola mentions but may show only the latest week.

D2SIDA men's: 2022-23 Week 3 and 2023-24 Week 4 pages not found; 2019-20 Weeks 1-4 all posted on 2019-12-11 so their release dates are unknown. 2025-26 D2CSC men's polls not checked in detail (hub not crawled).

NABC DII Coaches Poll 2017-18 through 2025-26 fully checked via Missouri S&T archive PDFs for dates found; 2017-18 to 2019-20 and 2022-23, 2023-24, 2025-26 had no Biola mention. Preseason polls for some seasons were not in the archive.

NCAA official DII West Region rankings: only found via PacWest releases (2020 Feb 19, 2022 Feb 23, 2023 Feb 22 & Mar 1, 2025 Mar 5). Other weekly releases (e.g., 2021, 2024, 2025 Feb, 2026) not located; ncaa.org PDFs not found. Biola 2020-21 (NCAA tournament team) regional ranks not found.
Biola was ineligible for NCAA rankings in 2017-18 and 2018-19 (provisional membership; Biola story says 2019-20 was first year eligible for national and regional rankings).
Women's 2017-18 NAIA preseason poll lists Biola under 'Dropped from the rankings' (Biola had moved to NCAA DII/PacWest).
Men's 2014-15 and 2012-13 (after preseason) and 2007-08: archived NAIA polls found contain no Biola mention (unranked, not receiving votes) where pages exist.
